13. (Currently amended) A system for electronically providing a[[ ]]n electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising:  
a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and  
an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data, and wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device.__

25. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having stored thereon [[comprising]] computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising:  
utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information;  
providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server;  
receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information __and the associated recipient data__;  
establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and  
provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein establishing the communications link with the mobile device comprises sending a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data and receiving, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data, and wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard coupon in the mobile device.__
